name: Khakhra
subtitle: wheat rounds roasted paper-thin and pressed until they snap

image.credit: Randhir. The original uploader was Randhirreddy at English Wikipedia.

prepNotes: The pressing is the technique. Each round is roasted slowly and pressed with a cloth-covered pad until every bubble is flattened out.
Roll them thinner than you think reasonable. A thick khakhra is a chapati.

steps.text: Make a stiff dough with everything and knead 8 minutes. Rest 20 minutes.
steps.tip: Stiffer than chapati dough. A soft dough will not roll thin enough.

steps.text: Roll each ball out as thin as possible, at least 20cm across.
Cook on a low tawa for 30 seconds a side to set it.
Now press continuously with a folded cloth, moving around the round, for 2 minutes a side.
steps.tip: Low heat and constant pressure. Rushing it gives a leathery khakhra with soft spots.

steps.text: It is done when it is uniformly pale brown, rigid and free of any give.
Cool completely on a rack before stacking.

storage: Keeps 3 weeks in an airtight tin at room temperature. If they soften, 3 minutes in a low oven restores the snap.
